description: This file defines data structures and functions for a simple Most Recently Used (MRU) list-cache used in the FreeType project, including node and list management, comparison, initialization, and lookup functionalities.

classes.name: FTC_MruNodeRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a node in the MRU list, containing pointers to next and previous nodes.

classes.name: FTC_MruListRec_
classes.description: Structure representing the MRU list, including node count, maximum size, node pointer, associated data, class, and memory management.

classes.name: FTC_MruListClassRec_
classes.description: Class structure defining function pointers for node comparison, initialization, reset, and cleanup.

methods.name: FTC_MruNode_Prepend
methods.description: Prepends a node to the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruNode_Up
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruNode_Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Init
methods.description: Initializes an MRU list with specified class, size, data, and memory.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Reset
methods.description: Resets the MRU list to empty state.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_New
methods.description: Creates a new node in the MRU list with a given key.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific node from the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_RemoveSelection
methods.description: Removes nodes matching a selection criteria.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Find
methods.description: Finds a node in the list matching a key.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a node by key, creating it if not found.
